text:
maria: Customer ACME opened a ticket — per-model throughput lines in the Console are empty since ~06:30 UTC. Global QPS is fine, API serving requests. Screenshot attached. Can we triage?
jonathan: Which model(s) are affected and do they see API errors or just the graphs?
maria: Affected model: redwood-large-v1 and two smaller variants. Customer says no API errors, just graphs show no series. Backend logs look normal.
kevin: We shipped the metrics exporter update in the canary namespace last night. Did we rename any labels?
maria: Not sure, seeing this in prod console (us-west-2). I pulled metrics from Prometheus: before the change we had metrics like:
```
redwood_model_qps{model="redwood-large-v1",region="us-west-2"} 12.3
```
Now the scrape endpoint returns:
```
redwood_model_qps{model_id="redwood-large-v1",region="us-west-2"} 12.3
```
jonathan: Ah — dashboards query panels expect `model` label. If the exporter now emits `model_id` the panel won't group by the right label => no per-model series.
sre-bot: alert:dashboard-series-drop: panels affected: console>models>throughput (occurred 06:32 UTC). Metric series count decreased 100%.
lina: Quick mitigation — we can update the Grafana panels to use a label_replace to normalize both label names while we fix the exporter. Example panel query (temporary):
```
label_replace(
  sum(rate(redwood_model_qps[1m])) by (model_id),
  "model", "$1", "model_id", "(.*)"
)
```
This will create a `model` label from `model_id` so the existing dashboard templating still works.
kevin: I can push a dashboard patch (readonly -> edit) and test on staging then prod. Long term we should make the exporter emit `model` again or update the dashboards and templates consistently.
maria: Customer asked for ETA. Can we restore visuals ASAP? Please cc SRE on the change.
kevin: Pushing a quick dashboard tweak now. Will post the panel JSON diff here.
jen: Also double-check alert rules that rely on `by (model)` — they may be missing and caused customer-facing silent alerts. We'll need to update those rules or add a compatibility relabel in Prometheus scrape config:
```yaml
relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: ["model_id"]
    target_label: "model"
    regex: "(.*)"
```
That buys time until we standardize the metric.
kevin: Patch applied to dashboard in prod, panel refreshed — maria can you confirm ACME sees per-model lines again?
maria: Confirmed with customer: graphs are back and match QPS. Customer is happy for now.
jonathan: Next steps: (1) roll back/exporter to emit `model` or add stable label in exporter; (2) update all dashboards/alerts to accept both labels; (3) create a follow-up RFC to prevent label drift. I'll open INC-2098 and tag eng-platform + monitoring.
maria: Filing INC-2098 and notifying customer with workaround steps. Thanks all :thumbsup:
